note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a ANT 6, 8, Schedule 2-3, MNA 3, Const 114(c); A06b ANT 6, 8, Schedule 2-3, MNA 3, Const 114(c); L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 6 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Antigua and Barbuda, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Antigua and Barbuda for 12 months immediately prior to the application (exemption for British protected persons), as well as during 5 out of 7 years predating the 12-month period. Periods of six months or more during which the person was not legally resident in Antigua and Barbuda shall not be taken into account. Person must have intent to reside in Antigua and Barbuda. Minister is explicitly allowed to waive certain requirements. ... n.a. ... n.a.
